headline: Iran tightens Hormuz closure; Australian inflation hits 4.9%; Trump gives Giuliani Medal of Freedom

austin.headline: Austin nonprofits stretch to feed families for the holidays
austin.summary: El Buen Samaritano handed out nearly 1,000 Thanksgiving meal kits and will add Del Valle, Manor and North Austin sites in December, while Central Texas Food Bank plans about 22,000 turkeys as its monthly food bill climbs to $1.3 million.

texas.headline: New ACA identity checks slow Texas health insurance signups
texas.summary: Brokers and advocates asked CMS to push the Dec. 15 enrollment deadline to Dec. 31 after new verification rules, with about 375,000 Texans among 760,000 enrollees removed nationally over suspected fraud.

texas.headline: Texas food banks strain under record holiday demand
texas.summary: Houston Food Bank bought no turkeys this year and High Plains Food Bank is serving a record 14,000-plus households a month after federal food programs were cut.

texas.headline: Paxton drops suits against doctors over transgender youth care
texas.summary: The attorney general dropped lawsuits that accused Texas doctors of illegally providing gender-affirming care to minors, the AP reports.

us.headline: Trump awards Giuliani the Presidential Medal of Freedom
us.summary: The former New York mayor, 82, was honored despite being disbarred and facing a $148 million defamation judgment over his efforts to overturn the 2020 election.

us.headline: Legal immigrants lose Medicaid under new federal law
us.summary: Hundreds of thousands of lawfully present immigrants are losing coverage under a provision of the tax and spending law, with more than 280,000 expected to lose Medicaid in October alone.

us.headline: States sue HUD over mixed-status family housing rule
us.summary: A group of states sued to block a HUD rule that would end housing aid for households that include members without legal immigration status.

us.headline: Shutdown risk grows as senators seek Iran-linked deal
us.summary: Senate negotiators are scrambling for a fragile agreement tied to Iran to avoid a government shutdown, The Hill reports.

us.headline: Trump warns holiday flyers about air traffic control system
us.summary: The president cautioned Thanksgiving travelers about what he called an outdated air traffic control system amid FAA ground stops.

australia.headline: Inflation jumps to 4.9% as power rebates end
australia.summary: Annual headline CPI rose from 4.3% to 4.9% in October, driven by a 25% rise in electricity prices, and Treasurer Chalmers flagged spending cuts in next month's mid-year update.

australia.headline: Australia and Solomon Islands sign security and economic treaty
australia.summary: Prime Minister Matthew Wale is in Canberra to sign the treaty with Anthony Albanese, and the ABC confirmed Honiara will not renew its 2022 China security pact when it expires in 2027.

australia.headline: Former police officer guilty of murdering Baird and Davies
australia.summary: A NSW Supreme Court jury found Beau Lamarre-Condon guilty of murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies after deliberating just over two hours; sentencing comes later.

australia.headline: Polls show One Nation surge ahead of Victorian election
australia.summary: A Resolve poll put the Coalition on 31%, One Nation 25% and Labor 20% on primary votes ahead of Saturday's vote, as Premier Carroll pitched a $460 million free dental package.

australia.headline: Greens back Labor trust tax for higher private jet fees
australia.summary: The Greens agreed to support the government's trust tax changes in exchange for higher fees on some private jet owners.

ai.headline: Trump's Nvidia holdings may have gained from Huang's return
ai.summary: Disclosures suggest the president held 32,000 to 370,000 Nvidia shares, implying a gain of roughly $1.3 million to $15 million from the rally, though the White House says he doesn't direct his investments.

ai.headline: Blanche and Patel sidestep questions on Huang investigation
ai.summary: The attorney general and FBI director avoided answering questions about an investigation involving Nvidia's reinstated CEO.

ai.headline: AI sell-off returns, led by Nvidia and Anthropic
ai.summary: Nasdaq futures fell as AI stocks reversed Monday's rally, and Anthropic shares slipped below their listing price.

tech.headline: EU unveils Quantum Act and €50 billion tech fund plan
tech.summary: The Commission proposed requiring post-quantum cryptography in high-risk systems by 2030 and a sovereign equity fund targeting up to €50 billion for quantum, AI and other technologies.

world.headline: Iran orders Hormuz shut further as Qatar seeks talks
world.summary: Tehran extended its closure of the Strait of Hormuz while Qatar tries to revive peace negotiations.

world.headline: Car bomb injures at least 24 in central Colombia
world.summary: A car bomb detonated in central Colombia, injuring at least 24 people.

world.headline: South Korea tells island residents to shelter as Russian jets approach
world.summary: Seoul issued a shelter warning to island residents as Russian military aircraft neared its airspace.

world.headline: EU court orders new timeline for farm cage ban
world.summary: The European Court of Justice ruled the Commission must set a new schedule to phase out caged farming after missing its 2023 deadline.

world.headline: Indonesia names ex-police chief a treason suspect
world.summary: Indonesian authorities named a former national police chief as a treason suspect in a case over wiretapping of the president.

world.headline: Pentagon criticizes Canada over military modernization
world.summary: The Pentagon sharply criticized Canada over the pace of modernizing its armed forces, the AP reports.

aus-cricket.headline: England crush Australia on Gold Coast to level T20I series
aus-cricket.summary: Aneurin Donald (85 off 32) and Phil Salt (58) put on 151 as England chased 8-184 with eight wickets and 41 balls to spare, setting up a decider at the Gabba on Friday.

aus-cricket.headline: NSW hang on for Shield draw despite Swepson's 11 wickets
aus-cricket.summary: NSW finished 8-152 chasing 282 at the SCG to deny Queensland, with Mitch Swepson taking 11 wickets for the match.

warriors.headline: Warriors favored over Kings in NBA Cup game tonight
warriors.summary: Golden State (9-8) are 5.5-point favorites against Sacramento (2-15) at Chase Center at 7 p.m. Pacific, with a seven-game home win streak on the line.
